name: Sniping (greater)
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 27
Aura strong illusion CL 15th
Slot none; Price +16,875 gp; Weight —
Description
This special ability functions as sniping, except the wielder gains a +15 competence bonus on Stealth checks to remain hidden after sniping with the weapon.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, invisibility, silence; Price 8,437 gp
